subject: market-fracture-ai-capital-cycle

state.label: MARKET_FRACTURE
state.description: Concentrated headline-equity resilience with broad internal tightening; credit/funding plumbing not yet in systemic transmission.

claims.scope: bonds, leases, SPVs, project finance and private credit
repo, securities financing and forced deleveraging

derivedResearchMeasures.capitalGap: AI capex growth - non-AI private investment growth

transitionContracts.F3_TO_R1: Sustained breadth and equal-weight repair with stable/lower rate volatility and orderly credit.
transitionContracts.F3_TO_R2: Leader valuation/time compression with stable earnings, broad credit and funding plumbing.
transitionContracts.F3_TO_F4: Weak-credit stress propagates into broad HY/IG plus material tightening in lending/refinancing/funding and broad negative earnings revisions.
transitionContracts.F4_TO_F5: Asset loss -> funding withdrawal -> forced sale -> collateral loss -> further funding withdrawal.

gaps: economic utilisation and return on installed AI compute
organic end-demand versus ecosystem-financed/circular AI demand
AI contribution to equilibrium real rates and term premia
private-credit/SPV leverage, guarantees, covenants and refinancing calendars
MOVE-to-repo/dealer-balance-sheet transmission if rate volatility persists
constraints: Currentness must be re-established before decision use
Poor breadth is not a deterministic market-timing signal
Credit repricing must not be conflated with a funding run
Contrary evidence of orderly broad credit/funding must be retained
